create.name: Veronica Varlow
create.bio:
Veronica Varlow is an American witch, tarot reader and author who teaches what she calls love magick and bohemian witchcraft, and who also performs internationally as a burlesque artist. She traces her craft to the Czech-Romani folk magic of her grandmother Helen, and she describes herself as a fourth-generation intuitive. Before teaching took centre stage she toured stages across Europe and Australia, including thirteen world tours with the musician Emilie Autumn, and she worked as a confidence coach on an Emmy-winning season of MTV's Made.

Her book Bohemian Magick, published by HarperCollins, is an illustrated handbook of spells, charms and rituals for confidence, self-love and making dreams real, written partly in her own hand. With her husband David she runs an online academy offering a ten-part tarot school, a course on writing and casting personal spells, and a virtual version of Witch Camp, in which students make their own illustrated grimoire of sigils, runes and spells. Witch Camp also runs in person, most recently at an art house in New Orleans, and she has led retreats in Mexico and Morocco. She also holds love and couples rituals at arts events in New York.

books.title: Bohemian Magick
books.author: Veronica Varlow
books.description: A richly illustrated, 240-page handbook of witchcraft drawn from her grandmother's Czech-Romani tradition, with step-by-step spellcasting, potions, charms and rituals for confidence, self-love and love.

courses.title: Love Witch Tarot School
courses.description: A self-paced online course in ten modules that teaches the tarot card by card, with a workbook, aimed at making the cards personal rather than memorised.

courses.title: The Spectaculus School of Spellcasting
courses.description: Six video modules on writing and casting one's own spells, with homework and quizzes; the companion course to her book Bohemian Magick.

courses.title: Virtual Witch Camp: Crafting Your Own Enchanted Grimoire
courses.description: An online version of her Witch Camp, in which students build their own illustrated book of magic, with sigils, spells, wands and runes, and work on their intuition.
